history.summary: A 2022 freehold 1BR (452 sqft) in Geylang/Aljunied (D14) at $779K / $1,723 psf, 610m from Aljunied MRT. Low quantum, freehold and near-new, but a tiny 452sqft 1BR, near-flat appreciation (1.6%/yr headline, 0.5% resale-only on just 20 txn) and a PSF slightly above the $1,665 median make it a fair-value rental play, not a growth one.
history.rating_rationale: $1,723 psf is ~3.5% above the $1,665 URA median for a niche 452sqft 1BR. Appreciation is essentially flat — resale-only 0.5%/yr on a thin 20-txn series. Freehold, near-new (2022) and 610m to Aljunied MRT support rental yield, but 1BR is the narrowest segment and the arena record (123-187) is weak despite a 662 score.
red_flags: Near-flat appreciation — resale-only 0.5%/yr on thin 20-txn series
catalysts: Freehold + 2022 build at sub-$800K — easy-to-finance entry
610m to Aljunied EWL MRT — solid city-fringe rental demand

history.summary: New (2022) freehold boutique 1BR in Geylang asking $1,723 psf, at the low end of recent transactions but a thin-cohort 'cheap' tag and small-format mass-market exposure cap the upside.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,723 psf sits at the bottom of the project's 12-month transaction band (avg ~$1,697, range $1,503-1,767, with a Jun-2025 #05 unit at $1,753), so the discount is modest and real but not dramatic. The dossier's -16% age-adj-cheap premium is overstated: psf_cohort_txns is only 3, so the comp base is thin. Per v3.4 priors freehold is not a forward edge and trailing appreciation (+1.6% on 20 txns) is near-zero. D14 (RCR) realized forward sits below OCR. Walk to 3 MRTs (Aljunied/Mountbatten/Dakota ~7min) and 4.6% gross yield support rental, but a 452sf 1BR in a 110-unit FH project competes with abundant similar stock. Fair value, not a clear bargain.
red_flags: psf_cohort_txns only 3 - the -16% cheapness signal rests on a thin comp base
Asking $1,723 psf is only marginally below recent average ~$1,697-1,753, so headline discount is overstated
452sf 1BR in mass-market Geylang FH segment - heavy competing supply, capped exit liquidity
Geylang location stigma may weigh on resale demand
catalysts: Direct bus to Paya Lebar Quarter / Orchard / Bugis; PLQ regional centre nearby
Freehold tenure preserves long-term hold optionality (no lease decay)
